the Gaussian check is a stop here (reported only in E294), as the card files it
the column rule is not read: new_few and new_thin are not rerun; E294's verdict stands

expected.moments: as E294: no expected value, inputs to S
expected.stage0_core: as E294: the source and the staged file match their filed sha256; any miss stops
expected.known_range: as E294 (predictions.json expected.known_range): our path, the staged class and the planted answers equal exactly; any difference stops

dW0.E294: stage0.json dW0 {t 0, S null}; m_floor.json dW0 {t 0, flags 0}
dW0.rule: F = M keeps no direction (stop otherwise); S undefined; no window flagged

lambda_max.rule: within the fp64 floor (ww_score.quad_floor), else stop

lambda_min.rule: within the fp64 floor, else stop

x2.rule: exactly 8 kept vectors at h.1.mlp.down_proj, else stop; its filed S recomputed here from the exact fp64 dW

parity.E294: x2: 500 windows, 75 test windows, 8 directions, FPR 0.04, no misses; the trigger: no misses

trigger.rule: share_T at least 0.95, else stop; T in a calibration window, under 73 free test windows or under detector ratio 10 stops (amendment 2); no gain up to 2^20 stops

gaussian.rule: mean S of the 20 Gaussian draws at e62/copy_s0's per-matrix norms within 3 se of 1; a miss stops (E306)

e62_S.E294: directions/e62-copy_s0.json S 1.6958, e62-lookup_s0.json S 0.9706 (and their seeds 1-2 in E294's directions/)
e62_S.rule: the six E62 states' S and kept counts equal E294's within rounding (the directions do not depend on the task rows); reported

expected.kept_counts: every Fig 4 state keeps 20 vectors in every monitored matrix the update moved; each sham keeps its item's count per matrix (reported, both; summary.json full_fine_tunes_keep_20, sham_count_misses)
expected.S: descriptive for every Fig 4 state: S against its 20 Haar draws (rank), its sham's S, S_cov and S_G beside; no band
expected.fig4_pairs: descriptive: per Fig 4 pair, each side's S and its shams' S, E141's pair rule on each, and the shams' spread (summary.json fig4_pairs). Card rival_a expects the pair rule on S to separate by more than the sham spread; rival_b expects it not to. No label is given either way

rules.trained_reading: E294's (ww_score.trained_reading) on every Fig 4 state: above all Haar draws is never read as reuse; reported beside S_G
rules.pair_rule: E294's e62_pair rule (E141's pair_rule: separates iff |mean gap| > the larger within-side range, strict) on each Fig 4 pair's S and, beside it, on its shams' S (ww_summary.fig4_pairs); descriptive
rules.flag_rates: as E294: compared only within a task set, an item against its sham and its M floor on the same rows
rules.stops: E294's stage-0 and trigger stops (inputs, known range, dW = 0, lambda_max, x2's 8, parity on x2, lambda_min, trigger token, trigger gain, trigger share, trigger parity) plus the Gaussian check; any stop ends the run and nothing after it is read

blind_to: the detector sees only inputs that move a hidden state outside the calibration range; anything F already does on Pile is absorbed
both readings see only the output side of o_proj and down_proj, nothing of q, k, v, c_fc or input directions, and only the top 20

S reads low when an update strengthens a direction M rarely writes along, and high when a new mechanism writes along a busy one (an unembedding direction); under s^2 pooling the matrix that moved most dominates
the Haar and Gaussian nulls are isotropic in output direction, so S above them may reflect generic alignment of gradient updates with M's high-variance outputs
the detector rows are each task's read windows (E53's are short), so flag rates compare only within a task set, never across Fig 4 pairs
